newsitem.title: UK: Haddon elected chairman of London Insurance Market.
newsitem.headline: Haddon elected chairman of London Insurance Market.

text.p: Ken Haddon, chairman and chief executive of Axa Re UK was elected chairman of the London International Insurance and Reinsurance Market Association at the body's AGM on Wednesday.
Haddon replaces chairman of Unionamerica Philip Marcell who also revealed at the AGM that LIRMA is developing a new index as part of a wider risk securitisation project.
Tim Carroll, chief executive of ERC Frankona is promoted to co-deputy chairman joining Stan Hardie of Skandia UK who continues in the post.

Members were told that two new organisations had formed links with LIRMA. Belgian broker Societe Anonyme d'Intermediares Luxembourgeoise (SAIL), a unit of U.S. Insurance Group AIG becomes the first European intermediary to use Lirma's electronic claims and premium clearing house. International Oil Insurers, a consortium of 16 underwriters with parent companies from Europe and Japan as well as Lloyd's syndicates becomes a full member.
LIRMA chief executive Marie-Louise Rossi said more new members are expected to join this year.

Tony Lancaster, chairman of GAN Insurance, Matthew Petzold, managing director of Copenhagen Re UK and Lisbeth Sarkozi managing director of WASSA International UK Insurance were elected to the LIRMA governing council. Reuters Insurance News +44 171 542 2770
